_comment: How a person reads to a party that doesn't know their name (operator, 2026-11-25: "NPCs should have generic descriptions unless the player knows their name which gets replaced as names are learned"). `stored`: their own unnamed_as, one short noun phrase, trimmed, at most unnamed_as_characters, no control characters; empty is none. `generic`: with none of their own, one built from their species (a species, race or creature_type tag), their Role's head noun (its words before the first to, of, at or from; a short one: at most 4 words and 40 characters, else left out; its words just capitalised lowercased and those with other capitals kept as written), and their gender (woman, man or person), with a or an; "a stranger" when nothing is known. wiki_shared/Names.unnamed_as_text and generic_unnamed and lib/names.unnamedAs and genericUnnamed compute the same.

stored.name: too long
stored.value: a very long description that goes on and on past the limit of one hundred and twenty characters for a short noun phrase ok

generic.name: an unknown gender word is left out
a long role is left out
generic.role: Retired sailor turned smuggler and cook

generic.name: a role's head noun, before to
a role's head noun, before of
a head noun before from takes an
a word with other capitals keeps its case
